has_flat_top(): synthetic 1.5-amplitude sine as float beyond 1 without a flat top -> False; the same clamped at +-1 -> True (mono, 2-D, one channel of a stereo pair, positive side only, negative side only); clipped at 0.8 -> True; two equal samples at the extreme -> False, three -> True; plateau below the extreme -> False; zeros -> False. Real files: sa3/raw 0 of 72 flat tops (50 have peak > 1), sa3/raw_clamped 39 of 72, moss 0 of 72, oga 0 of 21. raw_faults on thruster_2 s16: clamped -> ['clipped'], unclamped -> []. A plain 'three samples at |x| >= 1' rule would have flagged 48 of the unclamped 72.
Limits of the rule: a constant value held at the extreme counts (DC 0.5 for 1000 samples -> True); a clipped signal filtered or resampled afterwards is not caught.

points.verdict: mostly right; wrong or over-reaching sentences listed
evidence: See wrongSentences.

wrongSentences.sentence: the page LUFS column is -30.96 to -30.99 for hull and thruster, -31.99 for gear and -20.97 to -20.99 for shield, whatever the number of channels (and the column title 'page LUFS')
wrongSentences.problem: true as a number, but it is a convention (a one-channel file counted on both channels, +3.01), not the loudness the page outputs: own LUFS plus measured dry file>page gives -34.07 (hull), -34.07 (thruster), -35.09 (gear), -24.08 (shield), the family target. README says copies are set to 'the loudness the audition page plays it at', which read literally is 3.1 dB too loud.

wrongSentences.sentence: That -3.10 is the page halving the energy of a two-channel file while a one-channel file's energy is put on both channels
wrongSentences.problem: audition-level shows a one-channel file's energy is kept (file>page -0.09 to +0.33 dB), not doubled; the energy is split over the two channels. 'put on both' suggests it is counted twice at the output, which the measurement contradicts.

wrongSentences.sentence: one channel -0.09 to +0.33 dB with a median of -0.08, two channels -3.10 dB in all 6 and 10 files measured
wrongSentences.problem: the median of the six one-channel files is -0.07; -0.08 is from 16 plays in the screen-fix run.

wrongSentences.sentence: Measures only, no rules. `energyAbove60Hz` is the share ... a hint below 10 %
wrongSentences.problem: two hand skips (moss shield_3 s16, moss thruster_2 s12) were made only on that share (under 10 %), and the README's list of plain faults for hand skips does not name it.

wrongSentences.sentence: 21 excerpts of 10 items (hull 8, thruster 5, gear 7, shield 1)
wrongSentences.problem: the 21 excerpts come from 9 items (oga_cuts.json has 9 entries; oga-elevator-door was fetched and has no excerpt). 10 items were fetched.

wrongSentences.sentence: Three decoded .ogg excerpts peak at 1.004 to 1.008 before the ceiling is applied
wrongSentences.problem: four raw excerpts peak above 1: gear__lock-open-01 1.0002, hull__metal-slam-01 1.0039, hull__sfx1-metal-12 1.0078, hull__metal-hit-02 1.0085.

wrongSentences.sentence: the pages of rubberduck, bart, Cough-E and PagDev do not say how the sounds were made
wrongSentences.problem: rubberduck's '100 CC0 SFX' page says 'recorded with an android device' and Cough-E's door-lock page says 'made my own' (neither is a published item). True for the published packs of rubberduck (sfx #2), bart and for PagDev.

wrongSentences.sentence: It does not explain the thruster spread of 5.7 dB at the page ... this was not tested further
wrongSentences.problem: the cause is measurable and is not the loudness: the printout is energy per number of 50 ms windows above -45 dBFS (3 windows for MOSS thruster_1 s11 against 6, 11, 11); rebuilt from the files it matches within 0.2 dB.

wrongSentences.sentence: the thump comes at 0.75 s of the 1.3 s cut (sa3 thruster_1 s14)
wrongSentences.problem: the cut is 1.185 s long and the thump starts at about 0.84 s of it; 1.3 s is the file time of the cut's end (1.295 s).
